corpus: 9 SEC 10-K filings (AAPL, MSFT, JPM, GS, BAC, C, WFC, MS, BLK), 3332 embedded chunks
retrieval_config: hybrid: dense k=20 + BM25 k=20 + RRF k=60, cross-encoder top_n=5

questions.question: What supply chain and manufacturing risks does Apple identify in its risk factors?
questions.notes: Original question (revenue segments) had all-negative cross-encoder scores — Apple reports one operating segment, no segment breakdown in narrative chunks. Revised to supply chain risk, which is well-represented in Apple Item 1A.

questions.question: What cybersecurity risks does Microsoft disclose in its 10-K?
questions.notes: Microsoft has a dedicated Item 1C Cybersecurity section. Both chunks are directly on-topic.

questions.question: What liquidity risks does JPMorgan Chase identify in its risk factors?
questions.notes: 0021 is Item 1A explicit liquidity risk bullet. 0184 is Firmwide Risk Management section.

questions.question: How does Goldman Sachs describe its market risk exposure?
questions.notes: Goldman's Market Risk section appears under Item 4 (Mine Safety Disclosures label is a section parser artifact — content is MD&A market risk discussion).

questions.question: What credit risk management practices does Bank of America describe?
questions.notes: 0185 is consumer credit tables section; 0084 is the credit risk management overview; 0137 is risk control framework.

questions.question: How does BlackRock describe its investment management platform and assets under management?
questions.notes: 0001 is the Overview section intro. 0124 explicitly describes AUM-based fee revenue model.

questions.question: What regulatory capital requirements does JPMorgan Chase face?
questions.notes: 0579 describes Basel III components. 0043 is the capital risk factor from Item 1A.

questions.question: What competition does Apple face in its product and services markets?
questions.notes: 0015 is the competition risk factor. 0003 is the Business section competition discussion.

questions.question: How does Goldman Sachs manage liquidity risk?
questions.notes: 0245 describes the Global Core Liquid Assets (GCLA) framework. 0244 states the three liquidity risk management principles explicitly.

questions.question: What operational risks does Bank of America identify?
questions.notes: 0047 covers cybersecurity and information system risks. 0064 covers compliance and legal/regulatory operational risks.

questions.question: How do large banks describe their credit risk management frameworks?
questions.notes: Q11 expects any large bank; Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, BofA all qualify. Rank-1 result (MORGAN_S_0015) is a cross-reference stub, not credit risk content — excluded from GT.

questions.question: What technology and cybersecurity risks do both financial and technology companies face?
questions.notes: Cross-sector question. Ground truth requires at least one financial AND one non-pure-financial institution for full credit.

questions.question: How do financial companies describe their stress testing processes?
questions.notes: 0212 describes GS capital planning and stress testing. 0193 is JPMorgan CCAR section. 0137 is BofA risk control framework.

questions.question: What regulatory and compliance risks are common across major financial institutions?
questions.notes: Citigroup 0123 has a dedicated Compliance Risks section (section title visible despite DOCUMENT label).

questions.question: How do companies describe climate-related or ESG risks in their filings?
questions.notes: BlackRock leads heavily (ESG is central to their business). Morgan Stanley and Citigroup also have dedicated climate risk sections.

questions.question: What is Charles Schwab's approach to retail brokerage risk management?
questions.notes: Charles Schwab not in corpus (EDGAR CIK lookup returned no 10-K). All results should have negative cross-encoder scores.

questions.question: What are the current interest rates set by the Federal Reserve?
questions.notes: Real-time data question. 10-K filings describe exposure to Fed rate changes, not the rates themselves.

questions.question: What is Coinbase's cryptocurrency custody and risk framework?
questions.notes: Coinbase not in corpus. Crypto custody is not a topic covered by the 9 ingested filings.

questions.question: How many patents did Apple file in fiscal year 2024?
questions.notes: Patent counts not reported in Apple's 10-K. Apple mentions intellectual property broadly (APPLE_IN_2025_HIER_0005) but not filing counts.

questions.question: What is the employee Net Promoter Score at Microsoft?
questions.notes: NPS is an internal HR metric not disclosed in SEC filings.
